messages:
morgan: Heads-up: hit a weird parity issue between Node and Python SDKs in jsonMode when using function/tool calls in the starter-kit sample app.
morgan: Node returns a parsed array/object like you'd expect; Python returns a single-line quoted JSON blob nested in the tool result. Validator fails.
morgan: Example payload from Python SDK: `{'result':'[{"name":"x","score":0.9}]'}` — notice the outer string.
priya: Ugh. That sounds like double-encoding somewhere. Could be the retry/log middleware stringifying the body and then reusing it.
alex: Also check if the SDK's jsonMode flag is wired correctly in py. We had a similar regression where jsonMode only toggled the Node parser.
chen: Can you paste the schema and the exact call? I can try a quick repro in a container.
morgan: Schema (condensed): `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"score":{"type":"number"}}}}`
        Call: `resp = client.call(model='tool-x', json_mode=True, tool='search')` -> resp['result'] is a string.
priya: Immediate workaround: in starter-kit sample we can add a small helper `coerce_json_tool_output(v)` that does `if isinstance(v, str): try: return json.loads(v) except: return v` and run that before validation. Low-risk and unblocks workshop.
alex: Agreed. But we really need to fix SDK parity. Opening issue in SDK repo and adding unit test for py/js parity when json_mode true. Also add an integration test that triggers a single retry to catch double-encode regressions.
chen: When you open the SDK issue, include the logs from the auth/retry middleware. If a logging wrapper serializes the request/response body, it might accidentally persist that string. Also check order: auth -> retry -> logging should be the sequence.
priya: I'll draft the starter-kit PR with the coerce helper + test case for the quoted-array variant and link it to ticket INF-3490.
infra-bot: note: reported by onboarding-cust-2 at 2026-03-23T09:10:00Z. Creating INF-3490 and a follow-up SDK task SDK-1886.
morgan: Thanks. After PR I will run the workshop script to confirm no failures. Planning to include a short changelog blurb in starter-kit so new users see the workaround until SDK patch ships.
alex: Also, let's add a lint/test in CI for starter-kit that fails if `json_mode=True` paths get a string result in Python. That prevents regressions.
priya: Will do. PR in ~45m. cc @chen for validation test pairing.
morgan: Great, thanks all. :thumbsup:
